items.reason: Gap 0 describes a retry overlapping a running delivery where both pass the set check before the id is added, so the event is processed twice.
Gap 2 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a changed or forged header lets a duplicate through.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the refund handler is registered under refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; concurrency is described only among jobs in one process.
